querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      s_risk_earning_day,
                                      s_risk_variance20,
                                      s_risk_variance30,
                                      s_risk_variance60,
                                      s_risk_variance120,
                                      s_risk_gainvariance20,
                                      s_risk_gainvariance60,
                                      s_risk_gainvariance120,
                                      s_risk_lossvariance20,
                                      s_risk_lossvariance60,
                                      s_risk_lossvariance120,
                                      s_risk_glvarianceratio20,
                                      s_risk_glvarianceratio60,
                                      s_risk_glvarianceratio120,
                                      s_risk_revsvarratio,
                                      s_risk_kurtosis20,
                                      s_risk_kurtosis60,
                                      s_risk_kurtosis120,
                                      s_risk_beta20,
                                      s_risk_beta60,
                                      s_risk_beta120,
                                      s_risk_treynorratio20,
                                      s_risk_treynorratio60,
                                      s_risk_treynorratio120,
                                      s_tech_revs5,
                                      s_tech_revs10,
                                      s_tech_revs20,
                                      s_tech_revs60,
                                      s_tech_revs120,
                                      s_tech_revs250,
                                      s_tech_revs750,
                                      s_tech_revs5m20,
                                      s_tech_revs5m60,
                                      s_tech_rank1m,
                                      s_tech_revs6m20,
                                      s_tech_revs12m20,
                                      s_tech_revs12m6m,
                                      s_tech_revs1mmax,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_revenuetechnicalfactor.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.revenuetechnicalfactor WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
